questions.question: Who won the award for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 BAFTAs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sean Penn**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sean Penn** secured the award for Best Supporting Actor.
 
• He won this award for his performance in Paul Thomas Anderson's highly acclaimed film *One Battle After Another*.

**Comprehensive BAFTA 2026 Awards Reference__**

 
• **Major Awards & Acting Honors**

 
 
• **Best Film & Best Director:** **Paul Thomas Anderson** for ***One Battle After Another***.
 
• **Outstanding British Film:** ***Hamnet*** (Produced by Chloé Zhao, Liza Marshall, et al.).
 
• **Best Leading Actor:** **Robert Aramayo** (*I Swear*). He made history by also winning the public-voted **EE Rising Star Award** in the same year.
 
• **Best Leading Actress:** **Jessie Buckley** (*Hamnet*).
 
• **Best Supporting Actor:** **Sean Penn** (*One Battle After Another*).
 
• **Best Supporting Actress:** **Wunmi Mosaku** (*Sinners*).
 
 
 
• **Screenplay & Genre Awards**
 
 
• **Best Original Screenplay:** **Ryan Coogler** for ***Sinners***.
 
• **Best Adapted Screenplay:** **Paul Thomas Anderson** for ***One Battle After Another***.
 
• **Best Children's & Family Film:** ***Boong***. Backed by Excel Entertainment, this Manipuri-language film made history as the **first Indian film** to win a BAFTA in this category.
 
• **Best Animated Film:** ***Zootopia 2***.
 
• **Best Film Not in the English Language:** ***Sentimental Value***.
 
• **Best Documentary:** ***Mr Nobody Against Putin***.
 
 
 
• **Technical & Special Honors**
 
 
• **Technical Sweeps:** ***Frankenstein*** won three awards for **Production Design**, **Costume Design**, and **Make Up & Hair**.
 
• **Best Original Score:** **Ludwig Göransson** for ***Sinners*** (Ryan Coogler accepted the award on his behalf, joking he was busy with "a small independent film called *The Odyssey*").
 
• **Best Sound:** ***F1***.
 
• **Best Special Visual Effects:** ***Avatar: Fire and Ash***.
 
• **BAFTA Fellowship:** **Donna Langley**.
 
• **Outstanding British Contribution to Cinema:** **Clare Binns**.
 
 
 
• **Historic Milestones**
 
 
• ***One Battle After Another*** set a BAFTA record for the **most nominations (14)** and led the night with **6 wins**.
 
• ***Hamnet*** became the **most-nominated film by a female director** (Chloé Zhao) in BAFTA history with 11 nominations.
 
• ***Sinners*** became the **most-nominated and most-awarded film by a Black director** (Ryan Coogler), earning 13 nominations and 3 wins.
 
• ***Marty Supreme*** tied the record for the **most losses** at a single ceremony, going 0-for-11.

questions.question: As of 31st July 2025, in which event has India won the greatest number of medals at the Asian Games?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Athletics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Athletics** has been the most successful sport for India at the **Asian Games**. It has brought the country the highest number of medals in the event's history.
 
• The discipline includes a wide variety of events, such as **track and field, marathon, racewalking, and relays**, providing multiple opportunities for medal wins.
 
• India has won numerous **gold, silver, and bronze medals** in athletics over the years. Prominent athletes like **Milkha Singh, P.T. Usha, Neeraj Chopra, and Hima Das** have significantly contributed to India's medal tally.
 
• India's dominance in athletics at the **Asian Games** is attributed to its strong performances in events like **middle-distance running, javelin throw, and long jump**.
 
• As of **31st July 2025**, athletics remains the discipline where India has consistently excelled and secured the highest number of medals compared to other sports like wrestling, shooting, or hockey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Athletics at the Asian Games:**

 
 
• Athletics has been a part of the **Asian Games** since its inception in **1951**.
 
• The events are categorized into **track events, field events, and road events**.
 
• India has shown consistent performances in **men's and women's track events**, particularly in **relay races** and **hurdles**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Athletics Legends:**
 
 
• **Milkha Singh:** Known as the "Flying Sikh," he won the **gold medal** in the **400m race** at the **1958 Asian Games**.
 
• **P.T. Usha:** She earned the title "Queen of Indian Track and Field" after winning **multiple gold medals** and setting records at the **1986 Asian Games**.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:** The javelin thrower won **gold** at the **2018 Asian Games**, further solidifying India's legacy in athletics.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Sports:**
 
 
• **Wrestling:** While India has achieved success in wrestling, the number of medals is fewer compared to athletics due to fewer events.
 
• **Shooting:** India has excelled in shooting at recent Asian Games, but it still lags behind athletics in terms of overall medal count.
 
• **Hockey:** India's hockey teams have won multiple gold medals, but the number of events in hockey is limited compared to athletics.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games Performance Data:**
 
 
• India has won over **250 medals** in athletics at the Asian Games, including **85 gold medals** (as of 31st July 2025).
 
• The consistent performance in athletics has been a result of government initiatives, training programs, and the emergence of world-class athletes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Achievements:** He is the first Indian track and field athlete to win a **gold medal** at the **Olympics**, which has further boosted interest in athletics.
 
• **Infrastructure Development:** India has invested in **state-of-the-art training facilities**, such as the **NIS Patiala**, to nurture future athletes.
 
• **Support Programs:** Initiatives like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** have been instrumental in supporting athletes financially and technically.
 
• **Future Prospects:** With the emergence of young talent and improved training, India is poised to maintain its dominance in athletics at the Asian Games.

questions.question: Which Indian film won the Best Film award at the Asian Film Awards 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**All We Imagine As Light**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **All We Imagine As Light** is an Indian film that won the prestigious Best Film award at the Asian Film Awards in 2025, showcasing its excellence in storytelling and cinematic brilliance.
 
• The movie explores deep human emotions, relationships, and existential themes, resonating with both Indian and international audiences.
 
• Directed by a renowned filmmaker, it represents India’s growing influence and recognition in the global film industry.
 
• The Asian Film Awards are known for celebrating the best of Asian cinema, and this win highlights India’s contribution to the art of filmmaking on an international platform.
 
• The film’s exceptional narrative, direction, and performances by the cast played a crucial role in securing the prestigious accolade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Disciple**

 
 
• Directed by Chaitanya Tamhane, this Indian Marathi-language film was critically acclaimed for its portrayal of the struggles of an aspiring classical musician.
 
• The movie premiered at the Venice Film Festival in 2020, where it won the Best Screenplay award.
 
• It was also executive-produced by Oscar-winning filmmaker Alfonso Cuarón.
 
 
 
• **Gully Boy**
 
 
• A Bollywood movie directed by Zoya Akhtar, **Gully Boy** was inspired by the lives of Indian street rappers Divine and Naezy.
 
• It received critical acclaim and was India’s official entry for the Best International Feature Film at the 92nd Academy Awards.
 
• The movie emphasized the struggles and rise of an underdog in the Indian hip-hop scene.
 
 
 
• **The White Tiger**
 
 
• Based on Aravind Adiga’s Booker Prize-winning novel, **The White Tiger** is a film directed by Ramin Bahrani.
 
• The movie was released on Netflix in 2021 and received an Oscar nomination for Best Adapted Screenplay.
 
• It delves into themes of social inequality, ambition, and the class divide in India.

questions.question: Which organization conferred the "Rashtra Chetna Puraskar 2025" upon Dr. Gulab Kothari, the Editor-in-Chief of Patrika Group?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahma Kumaris Sansthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Gulab Kothari**, the **Editor-in-Chief of Patrika Group**, was conferred the **"Rashtra Chetna Puraskar 2025"** by the **Brahma Kumaris Sansthan**. This award recognizes his outstanding contribution to society and journalism.
 
• The Brahma Kumaris Sansthan is a prominent spiritual organization and is well-known for honoring individuals who make significant contributions to societal welfare and upliftment.
 
• The **"Rashtra Chetna Puraskar"** is a prestigious award aimed at motivating individuals who work towards national awareness and serve the public with their exemplary work.
 
• **Dr. Gulab Kothari** has been a prominent figure in journalism, known for his thought-provoking writings and efforts in spreading awareness on national and societal issues.
 
• The Brahma Kumaris Sansthan's decision to confer the award highlights the alignment of Dr. Kothari's work with their vision of promoting human values and spiritual consciousness.
 
• This recognition celebrates Dr. Kothari’s efforts in fostering intellectual dialogue and contributing to public discourse through his editorial leadership in the **Patrika Group**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Brahma Kumaris Sansthan:**

 
 
• **Brahma Kumaris** is a global spiritual and humanitarian organization headquartered in **Mount Abu, Rajasthan**.
 
• Founded in **1937** by **Prajapita Brahma**, the organization focuses on promoting spiritual knowledge, meditation, and values-based living.
 
• It operates in over **110 countries**, engaging in initiatives related to education, health, climate change, and social upliftment.
 
 
 
• **About Dr. Gulab Kothari:**
 
 
• Dr. Kothari is a renowned journalist, author, and thinker, holding the prestigious position of **Editor-in-Chief** of the **Patrika Group**, one of India’s leading media houses.
 
• He is well-known for his works that blend journalism with Indian philosophy and spirituality.
 
• Dr. Kothari has been the recipient of various national and international awards for his contributions to the field of journalism and literature.
 
 
 
• **The Rashtra Chetna Puraskar:**
 
 
• This award is conferred by the Brahma Kumaris Sansthan to individuals who have made exceptional contributions towards fostering national consciousness and societal development.
 
• It is one of the prestigious recognitions given to individuals for their work in journalism, education, spirituality, or social service.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Patrika Group:**

 
 
• The **Patrika Group** is a leading media house in India, known for its extensive network and influence in journalism and public information dissemination.
 
• It operates both print and digital platforms, reaching millions of readers across the country.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Journalism in National Awareness:**
 
 
• Journalism plays a crucial role in creating awareness, shaping public opinion, and holding power accountable in a democratic society.
 
• Individuals like Dr. Gulab Kothari exemplify the importance of ethical and impactful journalism in nation-building.

questions.question: Which state corporation received the 'Elites Smart Government Excellence Award 2025' for its technological innovations in healthcare supply monitoring?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**RMSCL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RMSCL (Rajasthan Medical Services Corporation Limited)** received the **'Elites Smart Government Excellence Award 2025'** for its outstanding contributions to healthcare through technological innovations.
 
• This corporation played a crucial role in **monitoring and ensuring the efficient supply of healthcare resources** like medicines, medical equipment, and consumables across Rajasthan.
 
• RMSCL has implemented **innovative technology solutions**, such as digital platforms and real-time monitoring systems, to streamline healthcare logistics and supply management.
 
• These technological advancements have enhanced **efficiency, transparency, and accountability** in the healthcare supply chain. *Hence, RMSCL was recognized for its efforts.*
 
• The **'Elites Smart Government Excellence Award'** is given to organizations for their exemplary contributions to the government's digital and technological initiatives aimed at improving governance and public services.
 
• The award signifies **recognition of RMSCL's role** in achieving better healthcare outcomes through technology-driven solutions. *Hence, RMSCL is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **RMSCL (Rajasthan Medical Services Corporation Limited):**

 
 
• **RMSCL** is a state government entity in **Rajasthan, India**, responsible for managing the procurement and distribution of medicines, medical equipment, and other healthcare essentials.
 
• The corporation ensures the availability of quality healthcare supplies to all government medical institutions and healthcare centers in the state.
 
• RMSCL has introduced **technology-driven systems** to monitor inventory, reduce wastage, and maintain efficiency in supply chains.
 
 
 
• **'Elites Smart Government Excellence Award':**
 
 
• This prestigious award recognizes organizations and government bodies for their exceptional contributions to **smart governance, digital transformation, and innovation** in public services.
 
• **Examples:** Previous recipients include government agencies, corporations, and institutions excelling in areas such as **education, healthcare, and technology.**
 
 
 
• **Other State Corporations:**
 
 
• **RIICO (Rajasthan State Industrial Development and Investment Corporation):** RIICO focuses on industrial development and investment promotion in Rajasthan. It is not directly involved in healthcare supply monitoring.
 
• **RSRTC (Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation):** RSRTC manages state transport services and has no connection to healthcare innovations.
 
• **RVPN (Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited):** RVPN is responsible for power transmission within Rajasthan and does not engage in healthcare supply monitoring.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **RMSCL's Achievements:**

 
 
• RMSCL has implemented **real-time monitoring systems** for healthcare supplies, improving efficiency and reducing delays.
 
• The corporation has contributed significantly to **public health infrastructure** in Rajasthan, ensuring timely availability of medicines and equipment.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Technological Innovations in Healthcare:**
 
 
• Technology in healthcare helps streamline processes, improve transparency, and enhance service delivery.
 
• Examples include the use of **digital platforms, data analytics, and inventory management systems** to monitor healthcare supplies.

questions.question: Which award was conferred upon Prime Minister Narendra Modi by the Israeli Parliament in February 2026?

options.text: Grand Collar of the State of Palestine

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of the Knesset Medal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred the Speaker of the Knesset Medal on 26 February 2026.**
 
• **He became the first world leader to receive this highest honour of the Israeli Parliament (Knesset).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights__** 

__
 
• **The Speaker of the Knesset Medal is the highest honour awarded by the Knesset.**
 
• It is rarely conferred and reserved for individuals who have made exceptional contributions to Israel or its international relations.
 
• The citation recognised PM Modi’s personal leadership in strengthening India–Israel strategic, defence, technology, and economic ties.
 
• This recognition highlights the deepening strategic partnership between India and Israel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In 2018, PM Modi was also awarded the Grand Collar of the State of Palestine — the highest civilian honour of Palestine.
 
• He received it during his visit to Ramallah from Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas.
 
• The dual honours reflect India’s balanced diplomatic engagement in West Asia.
